title: H.A.R.D. Protocol 0.3: MCP Server and Agent Skill (Public Preview)
description: Human-centered AI Readiness and Decision Protocol. H.A.R.D. Protocol 0.3 is a Public Preview for reopening consequential decisions in AI-assisted artifacts before bounded engineering commitment. Exact versions: protocol 0.3-preview.1, MCP 0.3.0rc1 and Skill/contract 0.3.0-rc.1. This preview adds explicit engineering-deepening triage, decision surfaces, bounded challenge scenarios and a smallest coherent next software slice while retaining six gates and fifteen criterion IDs. Decision compression is a motivating model, not an established causal effect. The protocol cannot authorize deployment and has not undergone controlled empirical validation. Original software is MIT-licensed; protocol and Skill text use CC BY 4.0. Development was AI-assisted. No new DOI is assigned here; the referenced DOI identifies historical rc.3 only.
